description.html: The HabiStat Dial Thermometer is a simple analog device for monitoring terrarium temperature. The round dial has a Celsius and Fahrenheit scale with coloured zones, so you can read the temperature at a glance. It uses no batteries or cables, and at 5.8 x 1.8 x 5.8 cm it takes up little space.

Reptiles are ectothermic and regulate their body temperature by moving between warmer and cooler parts of the terrarium. That is why it matters to know the temperature in each zone, not just under the lamp.

HabiStat advises placing the thermometer halfway between the hot and cold end for an average reading. For more accurate monitoring, use more than one thermometer and place them in the zones you want to check, for example one at the basking spot and one on the cool side.

A thermometer shows the temperature but does not control it: for stable conditions, connect your heating to a thermostat. We also recommend the HabiStat Dial Hygrometer for humidity, and you can find other gear in our equipment range.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
